facts.fact: 警报响起后教室大乱，一半以上一年级学员同时跳起来、椅子刮地、想逃
facts.quote: Over half of the first-years jumped to their feet at once, chairs scraping, breath going short and shallow.

facts.fact: 薇斯珀下令全体学员撤入地下避难所，学员列队鱼贯撤出
facts.quote: She ordered them to the underground shelters—every major building had one, for cadets and civilians.

facts.fact: 马克逆着撤离方向滑走、远离避难所，薇斯珀追了上来
facts.quote: I skated the other way, hard and fast, away from the shelters. Lieutenant Vesper came after me.

facts.fact: 马克抬起手臂时，腕上的冷铁护臂自行脱落并飞散成两枚环刃
facts.quote: I lifted my arm. The Coldiron armguard peeled off my wrist and flew apart into two chakrams, their edges glinting.

facts.fact: 布琳拒绝去避难所，要跟马克同去，理由是自己已在操练名单上
facts.quote: “Not a chance,” she said. “I go where you go. I’m on the drill roster now, remember?”

facts.fact: 德拉肯在战场中央当场变形：躯体向外折叠、骨与影拉长、金鳞如泼洒的硬币
facts.quote: his body folding outward, bone and shadow stretching long, gold scales pouring over him like spilled coins.

facts.fact: 马克助跑起跳，越跳越高并稳稳落在龙背上
facts.quote: Then I ran, leaping higher than I had any right to, startling myself, and came down cleanly on the dragon’s back.

facts.fact: 巨龙高飞硬冲，直插 mutant 大军、准备打乱其阵型
facts.quote: The dragon flew high and hard, set to drive straight into the horde of mutants and break their rank.
